subject: Renewal kickoff — capacity uplift, term options, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Sullivan <tom.sullivan@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal kickoff — proposed timeline, capacity uplift, and meeting options

Hi Tom —

Hope you're well. Per our pilot conversations this week, I wanted to kick off the renewal conversation for Atlas Health and outline a straightforward path to lock in the capacity uplift you requested. High level:

- What we heard: +50% baseline throughput, ability to burst to 3x peak for short windows, and a desire to move to a 24-month term for price stability.
- Options we can execute quickly: 12-month renewal (standard uplift) or 24-month commitment (discounted unit price + guaranteed burst bank).
- Compliance asks: you mentioned SOC 2 artifacts and a data residency amendment — we can include both in the amendment; I attached a draft proposal.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick alignment call — 30 minutes to confirm term and steady-state throughput numbers. Suggested slots: 2029-08-05 10:00 ET, 2029-08-07 14:00 ET, 2029-08-09 16:00 ET.
2) Once you confirm the slot, we'll (a) finalize pricing for the 24-month option, (b) surface SOC2 summary and retention amendment for legal, (c) prepare a DocuSign for signature.
3) Schedule a Quarterly Business Review (QBR) the week after signing to review traffic patterns and finalize the burst guardrails.

Attachments: RI_Atlas-proposal_v3.pdf (proposal + uplift pricing table)

If you prefer, I can loop in Procurement and Legal in the same thread; otherwise share the preferred meeting time and I'll send invites.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this smoothly.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — proposed timeline, capacity uplift, and meeting options

Logan — thanks for the clear note and the attached proposal. Quick responses:

- We are inclined toward the 24-month commitment for price stability; please price that option first.
- SOC 2 artifacts: Procurement/legal will need the SOC 2 Type II report and a short attestation we can send to our infosec. Elena (cc) will own the legal redline.
- Burst behavior: we need hard limits and an escalation path if burst costs exceed expectations.

Preferred meeting slot: 2029-08-09 16:00 ET works for the core stakeholders here. Please include Procurement and Elena in the invite.

Also: we'd like a short deliverable (1 page) that outlines the rollback/fallback if we hit performance regressions during the scaling window.

Thanks — Tom
